codes.safeCallerAction: Use the registered parameter domain and preserve required zero/empty distinctions.
codes.disclosureGate: REQUEST_SHAPE
codes.forbiddenInference: Never append native text, hidden IDs, counts, thresholds or private cause.

codes.disclosureGate: PROFILE

codes.meaning: The current endpoint cannot authorize this request.

stagePolicy.originInternal: Carry exact original host/Core/native branch and actual result inside the authoritative carrier. Internal origin identity is never a public source/path/line or hidden phase.
stagePolicy.visibility: PublicStage is optional and disclosed only when its category is independently safe. A protected native reason must not leak its subtype through stage, NativeEnforcementStage, array length, predicted-code flag or conditional obligation. Use fixed stage slots with absent value/Withheld semantics under the static operation registry.
stagePolicy.assessedVersusActual: Assessment stage names the native guard/enforcement location being described. It never asserts that execution reached it. Submission stage may describe only the actual returned first failure or actual carrier boundary. NativeEnforcementStage in a conditional descriptor is a declared condition, not a recorded event.
stagePolicy.candidateRollback: A later rejection can roll back candidate time/payment. Stage NativeContinuation never establishes committed elapsed time, expenditure or partial progress. Only retained committed facts/actual successful carrier can do that.
stagePolicy.automatic: Keep ordered assessed candidates, terminal-status candidate and actual executed candidate distinct. At most two assessments/one execution; no raw reason or candidate identity gains rights through the wrapper.

availabilityPolicy.facts: Keep existing closed Availability/TemporalMeaning registry unchanged. Primary reason/constraint metadata does not add Unrepresented or Pending to fact Availability.
availabilityPolicy.actualReason: A safely disclosed actual immediate rejection has Immediate/AttemptInterval if modeled as a fact. There is no later retained denial without a native causal record. Do not reconstruct one from current state.
availabilityPolicy.currentConstraint: Assessment uses a typed current constraint and separate InitialEligibility/CommitFeasibility/NativeEnforcementStage; optional current facts use ObservedCurrent/CurrentObservation.
availabilityPolicy.predictedCapacity: Unavailable may describe proven disclosable capacity impossibility. Never emit actual PolicyFailure/InvalidResult merely because an anticipated validator would reject. If an earlier path or future settlement is uncertain, do not predict its first native code.
availabilityPolicy.protected: Each operation has a fixed protected diagnostic slot independent of hidden cause existence, count or applicability. Always Withheld/no Value/Values/cause for that slot, including successful observations where required by the static registry. Neutral RequestUnavailable does not announce that a hidden entity exists.
availabilityPolicy.missingHistory: After current authorization, an unretained past reason is NotRetained. A field hidden by rights is Withheld. Missing required read data is ProjectionUnavailable, never NotApplicable or a fabricated ordinary denial.
availabilityPolicy.failureIsolation: If mapping/projection fails after actual commit/duplicate/reject, preserve that disposition and legacy response, set detail availability ProjectionUnavailable. Supported reads left routinely unavailable still fail qualification.

mappingAlgorithm: Capture one owning snapshot/context and current exact grant under the original session gate; preserve host/Core order.
Use actual first guard result for submission, pure shared first guard for current assessment, and a separately tagged predictable capacity result only under the agreed rule.

Resolve an exact internal mapping key: route + operation/variant/profile + original native branch + native token. A token string alone is insufficient because identical tokens can have different causes/disclosure.
Evaluate current disclosure before native cause existence/applicability, subject identities or parameters. Current native admission permission is not blanket detail authority.
Emit one fixed primary public category and static per-operation safe parameter/obligation fields. Do not enumerate later failures to create a hidden-state side channel.
For explicitly protected mappings, use RequestUnavailable with fixed protected detail shape, while retaining independently authorized public domain, own-budget, current-work and choice explanations.
An unmapped selected native branch is a blocking OPEN mapping: use ProjectionUnavailable for details during development, not an implicitly accepted generic redaction or unsupported operation.
Leave legacy result/codes, actual failed stage and all state/receipt/RNG behavior unchanged.
noExplanationWaiver: A protected primary cause cannot erase known source-bound costs, supported parameters, authorized current own status or a lawful real pending choice.
Each protected origin must name exactly which cause is hidden and which independent caller-useful description remains available.
A public reason is specific only where its prerequisite is already independently observable. For example, occupancy cannot be named merely because the command supplied that cell.
The API cannot promise an executable remedy. It offers currently supported controls/domains, not newly invented storage, cancellation, refresh, authority or acquisition mechanics.
Protected/generic mappings need negative noninterference evidence plus a positive authorized explanation witness; generic status-only output is not HC-D6 completion.

predicates.ENDPOINT: Exact current enabled seat/trusted route/grant and actor control at the applicable host layer. Does not itself authorize inventory, recipient, hidden cause or other-principal receipt.
predicates.REQUEST_SHAPE: Only submitted structure or an independently public static selected variant domain. A state-dependent preference/DC requirement is NOT pure request shape.
predicates.PROFILE: Exact published selected factory flags and already-public source/host operation restrictions; do not infer profile facts from a hidden current target.
predicates.OWN_ACTOR: Actual native own-character observation predicate O under current Controls and supported observation route; operator ClockGrant is excluded.
predicates.OWN_ITEMS: PHYSICAL P_ITEM/P_DOSE_ITEM/N_VESSEL_CURRENT/P_CACHE_STOCK as applicable, plus actual inventory permission, custody/access and independent parent/recipient/location predicates. Spent-dose history uses N_DOSE_USE only for historical fields.
predicates.OWN_RESOURCE: Own actor ledger (RP/Conviction/current allowance) or currently accessible authorized lot. Quantity UnitId requires approved P_OWNED_LOT_UNIT and exact reviewed finite binding; amount without unit is not invented.
predicates.OWN_PENDING: TACTICAL OWN_DECISION/P_SANCTUARY/P_PRESS or actual authorized quality/recovery choice; real identity/owner/revision only. Pending status cannot disclose someone else’s hidden offer.
predicates.OWN_WORK: MANAGEMENT W_BASE/W_CONTROL plus job-specific current controls and every I_CLAIM/I_VIEW/I_FILL_DEST conjunct; worker control does not authorize other-owned claims.
predicates.OWN_WORK_OR_TRAVEL: OWN_WORK or actual OWN_TRAVEL for the actor; safe own Busy may not disclose another actor, hidden booking or reservation.
predicates.PUBLIC_GEOMETRY: TACTICAL O/V/KNOWN and current public geometry; each target and obstacle fact independently authorized. Known cell does not imply hidden occupant/observer visibility.
predicates.PUBLIC_CONTEXT: Current own actor and already exposed ordinary/tactical/stationary context; private Director progression reason excluded.
predicates.PUBLIC_PREREQUISITE: Exact already-public source prerequisite plus the relevant current own/read/report predicate. Current history predicates do not authorize fresh unseen service mandates.
predicates.OWN_MAGIC: MAGIC O/C/R/S/B/H or actual own activity/casting grant as applicable; each recipient/cure/target predicate remains independent. Enemy contributions and contamination withheld.
predicates.PUBLIC_SERVICE_WINDOW: Current authorized P_APPRAISAL/P_SALE/P_MEAL/P_BILL/P_PLAN/P_AGREEMENT/P_CHARTER report/source window with exact current service-definition right; no hidden Director amendment details.
predicates.PUBLIC_BOUNDARY: The exact boundary is already disclosed under its independent current predicate. Generic native earliest deadline is not public merely because it blocked handling.
predicates.PUBLIC_CAPACITY: Only reviewed public profile limit and independently authorized count/quantity/claims explain the constraint; no global hidden records/booking count leaks. Aggregate capacity disclosure requires the open decision below.
predicates.TECHNICAL_READ: Missing/stale/foreign native read-context/checkpoint capability. Valid checkpoint proving no qualifying passage is a native prerequisite result instead.
predicates.TECHNICAL_PROJECTION: Projection/mapping absence or failure independent of native permission. Must not be used as a normal hidden-target classification.
predicates.RECEIPT_DISCLOSURE: Current endpoint and exact selected grant plus current Core actor/inventory/consent authority applicable to that exact command. Host may have already returned legacy conflict before Core execution; this does not authorize new receipt detail. Pure disclosure checking cannot reorder or relabel the actual legacy failure. No fresh original gameplay eligibility is rerun.
